_comment: jcode settings for the read-only review of La Reliquia del Alba (jcode 0.10.0-ma.5; vm/setup_reliquia.sh copies it to ~/jcode-projekte/reliquia/settings.json and never overwrites it). Executor only; the code under review is code/juego, read-only for the agent; reports go to code/reports/ with the model in the name. Budget 0 EUR. Keys only as environment variables in ~/.bashrc, set with read -rs.

sandbox._comment: Required: without a working cell jcode does not start. Inside: code/ writable only for reports/ (code/juego and code/.git read-only), no network, empty home: no ~/.bashrc, no keys, no other project, no /mnt/datos.

openrouter._comment: Free model (ID ends in :free): 20 requests/minute, 50/day without bought credits. Its free endpoints may log and train on prompts.

ollama-cloud._comment: Ollama Cloud free plan: usage limits per 5 hours and per week (GPU time, not published as numbers); no logging or training of prompts per Ollama.

nvidia._comment: build.nvidia.com, account exists since 2026-10-25; 40 requests/minute; NVIDIA may use the data to improve its models. Check the exact Qwen model id in its catalog before the first run.
